analysis.title: TotalEnergies SE (TTEF.PA): 3Q26 First Take: Solid results and WC release drive $6bn gearing drop qoq; $2.5 bn of buybacks for 4Q26 and 1Q27
key_insights: TotalEnergies reported 3Q26 adjusted net income of US$9.1 bn (GS table: $9,064 mn), about 2% above company-compiled consensus of US$8.9 bn. Operating cash flow before working capital changes was US$12.3 bn, 1% above consensus of US$12.1 bn.

Refining & Chemicals was a record at US$3,601 mn, in line with consensus of US$3,600 mn. Integrated Gas at US$1,885 mn post-tax was 5% above consensus of US$1,800 mn. Marketing & Services at US$467 mn was 17% above consensus of US$400 mn. Integrated Power at US$602 mn was in line with consensus of US$600 mn.
Upstream (E&P) was the shortfall: operating profit post tax of US$3,157 mn was 4% below consensus of US$3,300 mn.
3Q26 free cash flow before working capital changes was US$7.5 bn against GS estimate of US$8.2 bn. Organic capex of US$4.8 bn was higher than expected (GS estimate US$3,834 mn).
Net debt/equity (GS definition) fell to 16.5% from 22.3% in 2Q26 and was below the GS estimate of 18.0%. Net debt fell by about US$6 bn qoq, helped by a working capital release of about US$3.1 bn.

The company authorized US$2.5 bn of buybacks for cancellation covering 4Q26 and 1Q27. The board announced a third 2026 interim dividend of EUR 0.90 per share, +5.9% yoy, in line with GS and unchanged qoq.
FY26 net capex guidance is maintained at about US$15 bn, with US$11.2 bn spent in 9M26.

4Q26 production is guided to grow more than 3% vs 4Q25, excluding the Middle East conflict impact. That impact is decreasing vs 3Q26 and is estimated at under 5% of total production, mainly limited LNG exports via the Strait of Hormuz.

Average LNG selling price is guided above $14/mmbtu in 4Q26 vs $12.3/mmbtu in 3Q26. Refinery throughput is expected to be broadly comparable to 3Q26 (crude utilization 88% in 3Q26 vs 80% in 2Q26), despite a 20-day turnaround at Normandy.
GS stays Neutral with a 12-month price target of EUR 87.0, based on 6.4x EV/DACF applied to 2027E cash flow. The stock closed at EUR 83.60 on 28 Oct 2026, implying 4.1% upside.

market_movers.rationale: GS keeps Neutral and a EUR 87.0 target based on 6.4x EV/DACF on 2027E cash flow, after a 3Q26 adjusted net income beat of about 2% vs company-compiled consensus. Upside to target is 4.1%.

earnings_insights: 3Q26 adjusted net income was US$9,064 mn (reported US$8,263 mn), vs company-compiled consensus of US$8.9 bn and GS estimate of US$8,453 mn. Adjusted EPS was $4.07 vs GS estimate $3.79 (reported 29 Oct 2026).
3Q26 operating cash flow was US$12,255 mn (pre-OWC per text, US$12.3 bn) vs company-compiled consensus of US$12.1 bn and GS estimate of US$12,000 mn.
3Q26 FCF pre-OWC was US$7.5 bn vs GS estimate of US$8.2 bn. Organic capex was US$4,789 mn vs GS estimate of US$3,834 mn.

Divisional post-tax operating income, actual vs consensus: E&P US$3,157 mn vs 3,300 (-4%), Integrated Gas 1,885 vs 1,800 (+5%), Integrated Power 602 vs 600, Refining & Chemicals 3,601 vs 3,600, Marketing & Services 467 vs 400 (+17%).
Total production was 2,474 kboepd vs GS estimate 2,475 (-1% yoy, +3% qoq). Oil production was 1,510 kboepd and gas production was 964 kboepd.
GS forecasts: FY26E EPS $12.35, FY27E $11.13, FY28E $9.77. 4Q26E EPS is $3.41. FY26E EBIT is $41,410 mn.
FY26 net capex guidance maintained at about US$15 bn. 4Q26 production growth is guided at more than 3% vs 4Q25. 4Q26 LNG price is guided above $14/mmbtu.
risk_factors: Lower or higher realisation in oil and gas prices than GS expects.
Weaker or stronger refining margins than GS expects.
Lower or higher than expected recovery rates in mature offshore oil & gas fields.
geopolitical: The conflict in the Middle East reduced TotalEnergies' production in 3Q26. The impact is decreasing and is estimated at under 5% of total production, mainly from limited LNG exports via the Strait of Hormuz.
